choices.content: All four sides are equal in length
Only opposite sides are equal in length

question.prompt:
What is true of the four sides of a square?

[Figure 1](figures/cnm_p077_q2_question_en.svg)

solutions.explanation: All four sides of a square are equal in length, so A is correct. A square is a rectangle with this additional equal-side property.
